# JDK calls that read the JVM default locale. A decoder's result must not depend on it (#136),
# so the forbiddenapis plugin (configured in the parent POM) fails the build on any of them.
# Pass Locale.ROOT, or the locale the caller chose, instead.
#
# Do not edit this list by guesswork. DefaultLocaleApiAuditTest walks the JDK bytecode back
# from Locale.getDefault and fails when a reader is missing here; add what it reports. Whole
# packages are listed where a decoder has no use for any of the package.
#
# A method whose job is to use the default locale, such as ResourceBundleMessageResolver
# choosing a display locale, is marked with a package-private @SuppressForbidden("reason").

@defaultMessage Reads the JVM default locale; pass Locale.ROOT or an explicit locale
